subject.title: refactor: move non-session runtime journals to SQLite

question: Does a storage owner explicitly approve advancing the per-agent SQLite schema to v12 for ACP parent-stream diagnostics?
rationale: Repository policy forbids autonomous SQLite schema-version bumps, and accepting the persisted upgrade contract cannot be inferred from automated tests or the contributor’s branch alone.

options.title: Approve v12 migration
options.body: Accept the new session-owned ACP diagnostic table and require the PR to add real upgrade proof before merge.

options.title: Avoid the schema bump
options.body: Keep ACP diagnostics outside the per-agent persisted schema or defer them to a separately approved storage migration.

recommendation.title: Approve v12 migration
recommendation.body: Accept the new session-owned ACP diagnostic table and require the PR to add real upgrade proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The merged sessions/transcripts SQLite migration makes this person the strongest available adjacent owner for the per-agent storage-boundary decision.
